NGC2359._note: Common name only; OpenNGC has none

NGC7000._note: Published size 120x100 arcmin, integrated mag 4.0; surfBr = 4.0 + 2.5 log10(pi/4*120*100*3600) = 22.83

IC1805._note: Heart Nebula ~60 arcmin, V 6.5 (OpenNGC); same estimate formula = 24.02

IC1848._note: Soul Nebula ~150x75 arcmin, V 6.5 (OpenNGC); same formula = 25.26

NGC0281._note: Pacman Nebula ~35x30 arcmin, mag 7.4 (published); same formula = 23.58

IC1396._note: Elephant Trunk complex ~170x140 arcmin, mag 3.5 (published); same formula = 23.07

IC0434._note: OpenNGC B 11 over 90x30 gave 28.2 (the magnitude is not the nebula's light). Bright H-alpha strip behind the Horsehead ~60x10 arcmin, integrated mag ~7.3 (commonly quoted); 7.3 + 2.5 log10(pi/4*60*10*3600) = 22.9

NGC7023._note: Reflection nebula (OpenNGC 'Neb'; V 7.2 is the illuminating star HD 200775). Reflected light taken as ~2 mag (about 15%) below the star, 9.2, over the 10x8 arcmin bright part: 9.2 + 2.5 log10(pi/4*10*8*3600) = 22.6. Typed RfN/broadband: dual-band does not help it

IC0444._note: Faint reflection nebula (LBN 840); OpenNGC B 7.03 is the illuminating star and gave 19.4. No published integrated magnitude: set to 24.0, the level of other faint nebulae (Heart 24.0, Cocoon 24.0), so it is listed but never tops the shortlist

IC5146._note: OpenNGC V 7.2 is the embedded cluster/star (gave 20.8). Cocoon nebula ~12x12 arcmin, nebular light ~10 mag (faint; needs dark skies): 10 + 2.5 log10(pi/4*12*12*3600) = 24.0. Emission plus reflection, so 'mixed'

NGC2264._note: OpenNGC V 3.9 is the Christmas Tree cluster. Surrounding emission (Cone/Fox Fur) ~40x30 arcmin, nebular light ~7.5: 7.5 + 2.5 log10(pi/4*40*30*3600) = 23.8

NGC1976._note: Cl+N, so no automatic estimate. Published 85x60 arcmin, V 4.0 (nebula-dominated): 4.0 + 2.5 log10(pi/4*85*60*3600) = 21.9

NGC1499._note: California Nebula is H-alpha emission (OpenNGC 'Neb'). Published 160x40 arcmin, mag ~6.0: 6.0 + 2.5 log10(pi/4*160*40*3600) = 24.1

target._note: Rosette ~80x60 arcmin centred on NGC 2244; integrated mag 5.5 (published figures range 4.8-9; builder's choice): 5.5 + 2.5 log10(pi/4*80*60*3600) = 23.3
